title: Hazardous formwork conditions.
officialText:
Where an observed formwork condition hazardous to life, safety, or
health is not immediately corrected by the responsible contractor, the formwork designer or his or her qualified
designee pursuant to Section 3305.3.3.2 shall immediately report such hazardous formwork condition and such failure
to correct the hazardous formwork condition to the commissioner.
